description: Combined date and time picker with a calendar popup for the date portion and inline time input. Supports min/max DateTime constraints that cascade between date and time parts.

parameters.name: HourCycle
parameters.description: 12-hour versus 24-hour clock forwarded to the nested TmTimeInput. Default Auto follows Culture.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve HourCycle.Auto. Null uses CurrentCulture.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Focusable date trigger that does not open, hides clear, sets aria-readonly and tm-datetime-picker--readonly, and forwards ReadOnly to the nested TmTimeInput. Distinct from Disabled.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: Extra ids joined onto the date trigger aria-describedby together with the surrounding TmFormField cascade.

parameters.name: LabelTrailing
parameters.description: Content rendered at the end of the label row. Rendered only while set.

parameters.name: AllowTypedDate
parameters.description: When true (default false) renders a CurrentCulture short-date text field (`.tm-date-picker-typed`). A failed parse marks the picker invalid and keeps Value. The field shares the trigger aria-describedby; aria-labelledby names it from Label, with aria-label only as the no-label fallback.

parameters.name: DefaultTime
parameters.description: Time applied when the user first picks a date on an empty picker. Midnight (default) is 00:00:00; Now uses the injected TimeProvider (fallback TimeProvider.System).
